_help: Tunable numbers for the whole game. Edit and relaunch play.bat.
tickRate: simulation steps per second (fixed; rendering is smoothed between steps).
player.speedTilesPerSec: base walking speed at the 1.0x setting.
player.colliderRadiusPx: how fat the unit is for wall collision, in pixels.
camera.followLerp: 0..1, how quickly the camera catches up to the player each frame.
